convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom indicator (ColorStepXCCX) which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also depends on external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. The custom indicator would need to be reimplemented or its logic extracted.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamps

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: long signal triggers short close, short signal triggers long close (gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values = fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values = share of deposit fraction. The MM value of -0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a two-bar crossover confirmation: MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] (previous bar bull) AND MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] (current bar bear or equal) for long entry - this is a reversal/crossover pattern checking bar at SignalBar and SignalBar+1. The signal bar index defaults to 1 (previous completed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated on every tick without new bar guard. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on copy failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans gate which trade directions are permitted. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides the BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which handle all trade execution internally.
python_conversion_notes: The core difficulty is reimplementing the ColorStepXCCX custom indicator which uses JJMA and T3 smoothing from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The JJMA (JMA) and T3 smoothing algorithms are non-trivial and must be faithfully ported. The indicator has two buffers (MPlus/MMinus) representing bullish/bearish stepping values. Entry logic compares buffer values across two consecutive bars at the SignalBar offset. Trade execution via TradeAlgorithms.mqh is standard market order with SL/TP - the MM parameter dual-mode (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. No digit adjustment logic is present; SL/TP are in points as-is. The new-bar guard and Recount mechanism must be replicated for proper signal timing.
